Welcome to my channel! If you're passionate about holistic animal care, animal rescue, and all things animals, you're in the right place! My videos focus on animal massage, kinesiology taping, and various holistic therapies, along with behind-the-scenes glimpses of the animals at my sanctuary. You’ll also find videos about my travel adventures, interviews with animal health professionals, and plenty of cute and fun moments with the sanctuary animals.

Whether you’re a dog or horse owner looking for ways to support your animal’s health or a professional seeking new techniques to add to your practice, you’ll find valuable content here.

Discover more at www.HolisticAnimalStudies.org, and follow us on Instagram @holistic_animal_studies and TikTok @DrAngel811 for more updates and animal fun!
